observations: Contrôle image-prompt relu sur le candidat exact ia-comptabilite-confidentialite-donnees.
prompt: Isometric matte 3D editorial diorama. Two separated blank cream trays with a blank access card between. IMPORTANT: a VERY LARGE flat pure dark graphite #231f20 rectangular platform occupying 20 percent of the image; a large flat solid deep green #1c8a41 card occupying 10 percent of the image; bright green #27b657 tray accents. Keep exact dark colors, not grey and not pale. Background paper cream #fcfbf7. Soft upper left light. No text no numbers no logos no people no interface.
